lore3188_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere gentle pleasure, calm companionship] I would be glad to walk with you. We can speak along the way, and leave some quiet between the words. Tell me what you have noticed. A familiar path may still have something to show us when we share it with a friend.
lore3188_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would be glad to walk with you. We can speak along the way, and leave some quiet between the words. Tell me what you have noticed. A familiar path may still have something to show us when we share it with a friend.

lore3188_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm elder welcome, thoughtful patience, grounded] You found me. Come, sit a moment and tell me how the day has been. There is room for a difficult thought, or a small pleasant one. We need not hurry either of them away before you have finished speaking.
lore3188_greet_1.ogg.text: You found me. Come, sit a moment and tell me how the day has been. There is room for a difficult thought, or a small pleasant one. We need not hurry either of them away before you have finished speaking.

lore3188_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet reflective warmth, gently amused, unhurried] This shell is only a shell. Smooth beneath the thumb, a pleasing shape to turn in the hand. Sometimes that is enough to help a thought settle. I listen better when I leave a little space before the answer.
lore3188_idle_1.ogg.text: This shell is only a shell. Smooth beneath the thumb, a pleasing shape to turn in the hand. Sometimes that is enough to help a thought settle. I listen better when I leave a little space before the answer.

lore3188_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [deep patient reassurance, warm elder affection] Here is a place to sit. Let your hands rest for a moment. You need not bring me a question every time we meet. Your company is welcome too. We can watch the light move, and speak when there is something we wish to say.
